newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malawi stock exchange opens for business.
newsitem.headline: Malawi stock exchange opens for business.

text.p: Malawi's stock exchange opened its floor for trading on Monday for the first time, the exchange said.
The country's biggest insurance company, the National Insurance Co Ltd (NICO), became Malawi's first listed company on Monday.

South African investment house Simpson McKie James Capel, the lead managers, said at the weekend proceeds from NICO's offer of 15 million ordinary shares, which closed on October 29, amounted to 30 million kwacha ($1.98 million).
On Monday, when the exchange opened, some 60,000 shares were sold, Stockbrokers Malawi Limited chief executive Rob Stangroom said.
The first trading saw 40,000 shares being sold at 2.15 kwacha while 20,000 shares were sold at 2.20 kwacha during the second trading session.
The exchange market will be trading on a single price auction system from Monday to Friday from 0700 GMT to 1000 GMT.
